refined_question: For a fixed dimension d ∈ N, let a_j and a_k^* be the standard annihilation and creation operators on ℓ²(N^d; C), and let H and L_ℓ (ℓ = 1, …, 2d) be the closures of the operators initially defined on the canonical basis by H = ∑_{j,k=1}^d (Ω_{jk} a_j^* a_k + (κ_{jk}/2) a_j^* a_k^* + (\bar{κ}_{jk}/2) a_j a_k) + ∑_{j=1}^d ((ζ_j/2) a_j^* + (\bar{ζ}_j/2) a_j), and L_ℓ = ∑_{k=1}^d (v_{ℓk} a_k + u_{ℓk} a_k^*), where Ω = Ω* ∈ M_d(C), κ = κ^T ∈ M_d(C), U, V ∈ M_{2d×d}(C), and ζ ∈ C^d. Writing G for the closure of G = -iH - (1/2)∑_{ℓ=1}^{2d} L_ℓ^*L_ℓ, whose closure is known to generate a C_0 contraction semigroup P = (P_t)_{t≥0} on ℓ²(N^d; C), characterize precisely those parameter tuples (Ω, κ, U, V, ζ) for which P is an analytic C_0-semigroup.
equivalent_formulation: Equivalent formulation stated in the paper: under the unitary identification of ℓ²(N^d; C) with the normalized multidimensional Hermite basis in L²(R^d), replace a_j by (x_j + ∂/∂x_j)/√2 and a_j^* by (x_j - ∂/∂x_j)/√2, and ask the same classification question for the resulting quadratic differential operator. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2410.00416))
justification: The draft unmistakably targets Problem 2 because it reproduces the full operator-theoretic setup and even the closing heuristic sentence of that problem. The nearest official formulation in the paper is the sentence 'The problem is to find a classification of the set of parameters Ω, κ, U, V, ζ for which P is analytic' in Section 1, Problem 2. The surrounding sentences supply the needed notation: the definitions of H, L_ℓ, and G; the fact that G generates a C_0 contraction semigroup P; the non-degeneracy matrix K > 0 and the remark that sufficient conditions are known in that regime; and the explicit unitary reformulation via Hermite functions and quadratic differential operators. The last sentence about K > 0 and H bounded from below or above is presented only as a motivating 'one wonders if ...' remark, so it should not replace the main classification question. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2410.00416))
